## How this is produced (reproducible)

`gnucobol-rs-port-index evidence generate` joins the committed `parity-detailed.json` with a
scan of the Rust source's `#[cfg(test)]` / `#[cfg(kani)]` regions and fuzz targets. `evidence
check` regenerates and diffs (anti-staleness).
